activity.label: Brewing
activity.description: Creating potions with a brewing stand.
activity.rationale: Brewing is a core player activity with dedicated stations and ingredients.

activity.label: Building
activity.rationale: Building is a primary activity across all playstyles.

activity.label: Combat
activity.description: Fighting mobs and players with weapons and armor.
activity.rationale: Combat is a fundamental activity supported by weapons, armor, and projectiles.

activity.label: Cooking
activity.description: Preparing food using furnaces, campfires, or smokers.
activity.rationale: Cooking transforms raw ingredients into better food.

activity.label: Enchanting
activity.description: Applying enchantments at an enchanting table.
activity.rationale: Enchanting improves tools, weapons, and armor.

activity.label: Exploration
activity.description: Traversing the world to find structures, biomes, and resources.
activity.rationale: Exploration drives discovery of loot and rare materials.

activity.label: Farming
activity.rationale: Farming provides renewable food and materials.

activity.label: Mining
activity.description: Breaking stone, ores, and underground blocks.
activity.rationale: Mining is essential for obtaining ores and building materials.

activity.label: Redstone
activity.rationale: Redstone is a key activity for automation and mechanics.

activity.label: Smelting
activity.description: Processing ores and other materials in a furnace.
activity.rationale: Smelting converts raw ore into ingots and cooks food.

activity.label: Storage
activity.description: Managing and organizing items in chests and containers.
activity.rationale: Storage is a universal activity for inventory management.

activity.label: Transport
activity.description: Moving players and items via rails, boats, or minecarts.
activity.rationale: Transport speeds up travel and logistics.

environmental_property.label: Light Emitting
environmental_property.rationale: Helps players identify light sources for mob-proofing.

environmental_property.label: Vibration Dampening
environmental_property.description: Item dampens vibrations, preventing sculk sensors from triggering.
environmental_property.rationale: Useful for stealth and redstone contraptions near sculk.

equip_slot.label: Chest
equip_slot.rationale: Standard armor slot for chestplates and tunics.

equip_slot.label: Hand

equip_slot.label: Head

equip_slot.label: Horse
equip_slot.rationale: Horse armor provides protection to ridden horses.

equipment_effect.label: Flight
equipment_effect.rationale: Unique to elytra, critical for end-game travel.

food_category.label: Baked Good

food_category.label: Fish

food_category.label: Meat
food_category.rationale: Main source of hunger restoration from animals.

food_category.label: Mushroom

food_category.description: Edible items from the ocean like kelp, dried kelp.

food_use.label: Healing
food_use.rationale: Golden apple and similar items restore hearts.

food_use.label: Hunger Restoration

food_use.label: Taming
food_use.description: Used to tame or breed animals.
food_use.rationale: Some foods are used for taming animals.

food_use.label: Trading
food_use.description: Used as currency or trade item with villagers.
food_use.rationale: Many foods are used in villager trading.

form.label: Armor Piece

form.rationale: Distinct from tools and weapons in form.

form.label: Block

form.label: Food
form.rationale: Edible items are a distinct form.

form.label: Head
form.rationale: Mob heads are placeable and have unique properties.

form.label: Item
form.rationale: General catch-all for items that don't fit other forms.

form.label: Minecart

form.label: Spawn Egg
form.rationale: Spawn eggs are a distinct form for controlling mobs.

form.label: Tool

form.label: Weapon
form.rationale: Weapons are designed for combat, separate from tools.
